accounts_credential_only.name: accounts_credential_only
accounts_credential_only.value:
"accounts"."provider_id" = 'credential' and "accounts"."password" is not null
        and "accounts"."access_token" is null and "accounts"."refresh_token" is null and "accounts"."id_token" is null
        and "accounts"."access_token_expires_at" is null and "accounts"."refresh_token_expires_at" is null
        and "accounts"."scope" is null

memberships_archived_with_reason.name: memberships_archived_with_reason
memberships_archived_with_reason.value:
("memberships"."archived_at" is null) = ("memberships"."archived_reason" is null)
        and ("memberships"."archived_reason" is null or char_length("memberships"."archived_reason") between 1 and 1000)

audit_entries_actor.name: audit_entries_actor
audit_entries_actor.value:
("audit_entries"."actor_kind" = 'person' and "audit_entries"."actor_user_id" is not null and "audit_entries"."actor_api_client_id" is null)
        or ("audit_entries"."actor_kind" = 'api_client' and "audit_entries"."actor_api_client_id" is not null and "audit_entries"."actor_user_id" is null)
        or ("audit_entries"."actor_kind" = 'system' and "audit_entries"."actor_user_id" is null and "audit_entries"."actor_api_client_id" is null)

companies_name_latin_length.name: companies_name_latin_length
companies_name_latin_length.value: "companies"."name_latin" is null or char_length("companies"."name_latin") between 1 and 200

companies_archived_with_reason.name: companies_archived_with_reason
companies_archived_with_reason.value:
("companies"."archived_at" is null) = ("companies"."archived_reason" is null)
        and ("companies"."archived_reason" is null or char_length("companies"."archived_reason") between 1 and 1000)

company_settings_currencies.name: company_settings_currencies
company_settings_currencies.value:
"company_settings"."book_currency" in ('USD', 'SYP', 'TRY', 'EUR')
        and ("company_settings"."parallel_currency" is null or "company_settings"."parallel_currency" in ('USD', 'SYP', 'TRY', 'EUR'))

company_settings_rate_types.name: company_settings_rate_types
company_settings_rate_types.value:
"company_settings"."book_rate_type" in ('market', 'bulletin')
        and ("company_settings"."parallel_rate_type" is null or "company_settings"."parallel_rate_type" in ('market', 'bulletin'))

company_settings_parallel_complete.name: company_settings_parallel_complete
company_settings_parallel_complete.value:
("company_settings"."parallel_currency" is null) = ("company_settings"."parallel_rate_type" is null)
        and ("company_settings"."parallel_currency" is null) = ("company_settings"."parallel_accepts_transaction_rate" is null)

company_settings_transaction_rate_market.name: company_settings_transaction_rate_market_only
company_settings_transaction_rate_market.value:
(not "company_settings"."book_accepts_transaction_rate" or "company_settings"."book_rate_type" = 'market')
        and ("company_settings"."parallel_accepts_transaction_rate" is not true or "company_settings"."parallel_rate_type" = 'market')
